newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Tuesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down slightly on the yen's weakness against the U.S. dollar and on some sporadic long-liquidation.

"There were probably some trades done in the morning, but volume was probably small. Prices fell across the board in the afternoon on some late local selling interest on the back of weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, December RSS3 slipped half a cent to 126.00 U.S. cents a kg.
December RSS1 slipped half a cent to 180.50 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg.
December TSR20 fell 1.25 cents to 175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg.
